# `Q-3-40` — Invalid Metadata Structure

> Document metadata must be a map structure for this output
> format.

## What this means

A document's metadata — what you write in the `---` front matter
— is structured as a map: keys to values. The writer expects
the AST's metadata field to hold that map shape. This error
fires when the writer finds something else there: a list at the
top level, a scalar, or `null`.

## Why this happens

The most common cause is a Lua filter that rewrites
`Pandoc.meta` to a non-map value, either as part of a
metadata-manipulation pass or by accident. Hand-edited AST input
(via `--from json`) can also trigger the error.

The default Quarto pipeline does not produce non-map metadata.

## How to fix

If a Lua filter is in use, audit any code that assigns to
`Pandoc.meta` directly. Metadata operations should preserve the
top-level map shape; modify keys, do not replace the whole
container with a different type.

If the failing input came from a tool that emitted JSON
directly, fix the tool to wrap top-level metadata as
`{"t": "MetaMap", "c": {...}}` (or whichever map form your
toolchain emits).
